# House2Home

> > House2Home is Ireland's SEAI One Stop Shop providing deep retrofit services, solar PV installation, insulation upgrades, and heat pump solutions with comprehensive grant support.

House2Home helps Irish homeowners improve their BER ratings through energy-efficient retrofits, offering end-to-end project management from BER assessments to installation. The company operates as an authorized SEAI contractor network, delivering solutions aligned with Ireland's Climate Action plan including attic insulation, solar panels, heat pumps, and whole-home energy upgrades.

## Key Topics

- SEAI grants and funding
- Deep retrofit projects
- BER (Building Energy Rating) assessments
- Solar PV installation
- Attic insulation with Rockwool
- Heat pumps and MVHR systems
- Home Energy Upgrade Scheme
- Energy efficiency improvements
- Heat loss prevention
- Draft proofing and weatherstripping
- SEAI One Stop Shop services
- Retrofit planning and preparation
- Irish Climate Action plan compliance
- Energia solar bundles
- Thermal performance optimization
